#rounding numbers to a specific number of decimal places

```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
```{r}
print(seq(by = 2, from = 1, to = 10))
```
#Repeating numbers
```{r}
print(rep(2, 5))
print(rep(x = 2, times = 5))
```
```{r}
print(rep(5, 7))
```
#Numeric
```{r}
x <- 4e-3
print(x)
```
#Character variable
```{r}
x <- "I am a variable"
print(x)
```
```{r}
x <- "hi there"
print(class(x))
```
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
Treated_1 <- TRUE
Treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543
```
```{r}
install.packages("fortunes")
library(fortunes)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
#Combine the variables into vectors
cell_Id_vec <- c(cell_ID_1,cell_ID_2)
Treated_vec <- c(Treated_1,Treated_2)
num_cells_before_vec <- c(num_cells_before_1,num_cells_before_2)
num_cells_after_vec <- c(num_cells_after_1,num_cells_after_2)
```
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
x <- all_my_pets[4]
print(x)

```

```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)


print(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
my_data_frame <- tibble(
  fruit = c("apple", "pear", "banana"),
  length = c(22, 30, 55),
  weight = c(150, 165, 170)
)

gt(my_data_frame)
```
```{r}
Radiation_data <- tibble(
  Cell_ID = c("CX1","CX2"),
  Treated = c("True","False"),
  Num_cells_before = c(5415,8123),
  Num_cells_after = c(1432,7543)
)
gt(Radiation_data)
```
